study.title: Coronary artery stenosis detection via proposal-shifted spatial-temporal transformer in X-ray angiography

imaging.modality_detail: X-ray coronary angiography (XRA) video sequences, 512x512, 0.3 mm x 0.3 mm resolution
imaging.territory_detail: Left and right coronary arteries (stenosis detection)
imaging.frames_per_sequence: 9 consecutive contrast-filled frames selected per video; model input T = 5 consecutive frames

public_dataset_used.detail: COCO used only for ResNet50 backbone pretraining; study data are private

annotation.annotator_expertise: Experienced interventional radiologists; bounding boxes, average annotations taken as ground truth

task.task_description: Bounding-box detection of coronary artery stenoses in XRA sequences using a Faster R-CNN-style detector with a proposal-shifted spatio-temporal Transformer feature aggregation module (PSSTT + TFA).
task.clinical_application: Automatic stenosis detection to assist diagnosis of coronary artery disease

temporal_evidence.quote: the tokens are fed into the Transformer-based feature aggregation (TFA) block to model the spatio-temporal interaction for the feature aggregation from all frames of the input sequence

method.pretraining: ResNet50 backbone initialized with COCO pre-trained weights

G3.quote: most of these methods [8,10,11] only use the spatial information in each single frame for stenosis detection, not exploiting the inter-frame context relationship of the XRA sequence

G4.quote: Due to the overlapping vessel structures caused by the projection in XRA images, a multi-view learning strategy is promising to further improve stenosis detection accuracy.

other_limitations: Relies on hand-crafted components such as dense anchor generation (not fully end-to-end)
Does not quantify stenosis degree, which is further required clinically
Separate detection then quantification would accumulate errors
future_work: Integrate PSTFA module into DETR or Deformable DETR for fully end-to-end detection
Multi-view learning strategy to handle projection overlap
Multitask learning to jointly detect and quantify stenosis
